summary.purpose: reform_opening's 【紅軍派系】 ("每回合可檢視1次牌庫頂3張牌，將其以任意順序放回牌庫頂，並抽1張牌") had no implementation: the ability name was missing from _resolve_ability_text and _activated_faction_action had no branch for it. Implemented by reusing the existing era_inspect_deck_top_and_reorder multi-card choice with a draw_after_reorder context flag. Also added a backend ability-ownership gate to _activated_faction_action (previously ANY faction could invoke any named non-red faction action via WebSocket; only the frontend filtered by faction), and added 民族祭儀 to the ability-name mapping so its existing runtime branch passes the new gate for its 12 factions.
